title: Lithuania Faces a Double Squeeze: Sticky Inflation and a Fragile Coalition… · 15 Aug
keywords: Lithuania, inflation, coalition politics, Baltic states, EU economy, unemployment, cost of living, eurozone, NATO, political stability, governance
notes: Lithuania's economy continues to grow, but elevated prices and a cooling labour market mean that recovery remains largely invisible to ordinary households. At the same time, the governing coalition, recently reconstituted with a 75-seat majority, is showing signs of internal strain that could complicate the country's ability to address those very pressures.
